summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for $100 million of 7.00% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due October 1, 2036. Fixed at 7.00% until October 1, 2031, then Three-Month Term SOFR plus 222 bp, paid quarterly. Priced at par (100.00%), underwriter discount 1.25%, net proceeds $98.75 million; settlement T+2. Notes are unsecured, subordinated, structurally junior to bank subsidiary liabilities, non-convertible, unlisted, callable from October 1, 2031 with Federal Reserve approval. Watch regulatory capital treatment and credit-spread reception.
